text:
Alex K.: heads up — just pushed a tiny rename + formatting tweak in #PR-2419. CI is failing the linter though, not sure if it’s my fault or pre-commit flakiness.
Maria L.: can you paste the failing lint output? sometimes the gofmt/gofumpt hook changes a couple things.
Alex K.: sure — CI error: `gofumpt: file pkg/serve/handler.go: gofumpt -w suggested changes`
Alex K.: locally `gofmt` looks clean, running `gofumpt` now.
ci-bot: CI update — build failed on commit a1b2c3 (PR #2419). Failed checks: gofumpt, staticcheck. Full logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/2419/logs
Priya S.: i can take the staticcheck bits after you reformat. if gofumpt diff is small we can squash and merge into the current merge window.
Alex K.: running `gofumpt -w pkg/serve/handler.go` — here's the diff I see:
```
- func Serve(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
-    // handle
- }
+func Serve(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+    // handle
+}
```
Alex K.: also a couple trailing whitespace removals, nothing functional.
Maria L.: thanks. can you run `git add -A && git commit --amend --no-edit` then push with `--force-with-lease` so CI picks up the cleaned commit?
Alex K.: done — pushed a1b2c3 -> a1b2c3 (force-with-lease). re-running CI.
ci-bot: CI update — build passing on commit a1b2c3 (PR #2419). Checks: gofumpt ✅, staticcheck ✅, unit tests ✅.
Jamie R.: nice. any blockers for merge or should we land in the 16:00 merge window?
Priya S.: no blockers from me, but can we ensure the changelog entry includes the rename note? small public API change.
Alex K.: added a short changelog line in docs/changes.md. pinging @Maria L. for final approve.
Maria L.: reviewed, looks good. :thumbsup: Approving now. please squash if you want single commit.
Alex K.: squashed, merging during the 16:00 slot. thanks everyone.
Jamie R.: :eyes: thanks for the quick turnaround — appreciate the follow-through on the formatter hooks.
Priya S.: small reminder: if anyone hits gofumpt locally, `brew install gofumpt` or use the pre-commit hook to avoid CI surprises.
